Per-axis cap 100 / total 500; re-array disabled after (double-burn guard). Design-time offers only in-place Duplicate (Cmd+D); no grid/circular/radial/offset array (arrange = align+distribute only).

categories.summary: Auto-fit is 'Fit to board' (ADR-125 D1): fitObjectToRegion generalizes fit-to-bed to scale-to-fit-and-center the ONE selected design into the board region, rotation-safe (uses the rotated footprint AABB so a rotated design cannot overflow the physical board), grow flag scales small designs up. Fill-the-board = uniform grid of copies of one design (auto-count). Single-design only; multi-select is a no-op.

categories.summary: Stock shapes = rectangle + circle only. Captured board is a BoardShape union {rect | circle} (ADR-126): rect from four-corner or one-corner+typed size; circle from centre + typed/measured diameter (fit/array use its inscribed square). CNC stock is rectangular (CncStock) with optional job-tiling (CncTiling, Phase H.10/F-CNC19) that splits an oversized job into a bed-sized overlapping tile grid with registration holes for re-indexing. No arbitrary custom-outline stock, no offcut/remnant support.
